binding_population_definition: post-m2, in scope, decisive, ranked games on Autarky, Maze or Trauma in manifest v2 whose series has no game in P-2's training rows (consumed_by does not contain P-2); 1,328 games: Autarky 435, Maze 446, Trauma 447

bootstrap.unit: whole series, one draw shared across cells and both models

min_cell_rule: a cell with fewer than min_cell_games games in the binding population is report-only; the list is fixed from outcome-free counts before the claim
slope_rule: abs(slope_V - 1) <= abs(slope_Phi - 1) + slope_tol in every binding cell from slope_from_round
rl50_rule: binding: AUC_V >= AUC_Phi at round-limit r50 in the binding population; reported, not binding: AUC_V >= rl50_min_auc
incomplete_if: a binding cell has one outcome class
any binding metric is not finite
fewer than min_valid_draws valid bootstrap draws
coverage below min_coverage_per_map on any held-out map
claim hash or scorer hash differs from the audited ones
verdict: PASS only if every binding clause holds; otherwise FAIL; INCOMPLETE as listed. One claim, one score. A failed or incomplete run keeps its receipt and is not repeated.
estimand: performance on the three fixed held-out maps, each reported separately; not a claim about unseen maps in general
